usedFor: NextLead manages leads and sales, with “Create Contact”, “Update Lead” and “Create a sale” keeping records current.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Contact” in NextLead
bestTemplate.why: A message from a new person becomes a contact in NextLead before it is forgotten.

watchOut: “Delete Contact” and “Delete a sales deal” remove records, so keep them out of automatic steps.
